_readme: S748 (lane 1, readers). El Camino's Architecture Certificate of Achievement 19857 is held since S741: its record (run 44480396671, its own page, poid 3524) adds to 33 where the page prints 'Total Units: 36', and S741's read of the page (run 45953358884) found 'Required Core: 30 units' over nine courses that add to 27. total_differs is filed only from a page a session read (kb/program_total_differs.json). This read prints the certificate's own page as the capture reads it, alone in its log, so a session can read each course's units, the 'Required Core' figure, the '6 units from:' list and the total word for word. One load, no model call, nothing written.

http_hosts.catalog.elcamino.edu: the registry's catalog address is http://catalog.elcamino.edu/, and the harvest's capture reads every program page at that address, so each filed source and record carries it; this read asks for the same page as filed

questions.figures: Each course the Architecture certificate's page prints with its units, the figure it prints beside 'Required Core', the '6 units from:' list, and the total.
